% Editing-fixture corpus for Beamer canvas text editing
% (design/beamer-canvas-editing.md, "Editing fixture corpus"): command-form
% frame titles, explicit line breaks, \vfill, macro calls with arguments,
% nested lists, empty items, description labels, multi-step overlays,
% graphics size variants, and a fragile/verbatim frame.
\documentclass{beamer}
\newcommand{\inner}[2]{\(\langle #1, #2\rangle\)}
\newcommand{\highlight}[1]{\textbf{#1}}
\begin{document}

\begin{frame}
\frametitle[Short title]{Command-form title}
\framesubtitle{Command-form subtitle}
First line \\ second line
\vfill
Signed with \inner{x}{y} and \highlight{a wrapped phrase}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Nested lists}
\begin{itemize}
\item Outer first
\begin{enumerate}
\item Nested numbered
\end{enumerate}
\item
\item Outer after empty
\end{itemize}
\begin{description}
\item[Gradient] Points uphill
\item[Hessian] Curves the bowl
\end{description}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Overlay steps}
Always visible
\pause
Revealed second
\alt<3>{Alt on three}{Alt otherwise}
\temporal<2>{Temporal before}{Temporal during}{Temporal after}
\begin{itemize}[<+->]
\item Incremental one
\item Incremental two
\end{itemize}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Graphics sizes}
\includegraphics[width=3cm]{plots/loss-curve}
\includegraphics[height=2cm]{diagrams/architecture}
\includegraphics[scale=0.5]{photos/team}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[fragile]{Verbatim listing}
Prose before the listing
\begin{verbatim}
for step in range(10):
    loss.backward()
\end{verbatim}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
